question: The marked price of an article is Rs. 400. A shopkeeper sells it by giving two successive discounts of 12% and 20% on its marked price. If he earns a profit of 10%, then the cost price of the article is:
solution:
Given:

Concept used:

Selling price = Marked price × (1 - Discount Percentage/100)

Selling price = Cost price (1 + profit percentage/100)

Calculation:

Price after first discount = 400 × 0.88 = Rs. 352

The final selling price = 352 × 0.8 = 281.6

Let the cost price of the article be P
